user.title: Connect a Teltonika router
user.description: Use a RutOS user with API access. A dedicated user with the minimum rights is recommended.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the router, for example 192.168.1.1. Use http:// in front to talk plain HTTP.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave off if the router uses its self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The router {host} rejected the stored password.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: This is a different router than the one configured.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the status of the router is polled (signal, uplink, modem, GPS, load).
data_description.config_interval: How often pages that rarely change are read again (Wi-Fi and WireGuard configuration, 30 to 3600 seconds, default 300). Actions of this integration read them again at once. A higher value keeps the load on the router low.
data_description.probe_url: Must answer HTTP 204 when the internet works. Used to detect a hotspot login page. Leave empty to turn the check off.
data_description.vpn_host: A DNS name, IPv4 or IPv6 address of a device behind your VPN tunnel, for example the router at your home base. Checked from the Home Assistant host. Leave empty to turn the check off.
data_description.vpn_port: A TCP port to connect to. A refused connection also counts as reachable, because the device answered through the tunnel.

error.invalid_vpn_host: Enter a plain DNS name or IP address, optionally with a port, without http:// or a path.

router_not_found.message: The selected device is not a loaded Teltonika Control router.

portal_mode.name: Wait for hotspot login
portal_mode.description: Prefers Wi-Fi and waits until the hotspot login page is confirmed. Falls back to mobile data if there is no internet in time.       Fires the teltonika_control_portal_result event.

minutes.name: Wait time
minutes.description: How long to wait for the login.

set_priority.name: Set uplink priority
set_priority.description: Prefers Wi-Fi or mobile data. With verification, Wi-Fi is rolled back when it       has no internet after 25 seconds.

wifi_first.name: Wi-Fi first
wifi_first.description: On prefers Wi-Fi, off prefers mobile data.

verify.name: Verify internet
verify.description: Roll back to mobile data when Wi-Fi has no internet.

scan_wifi.name: Scan for Wi-Fi networks
scan_wifi.description: Scans for networks and returns them.       Without a radio, all radios are scanned.

radio.name: Radio
radio.description: Radio to scan with, for example radio0.

join_wifi.name: Save Wi-Fi network
join_wifi.description: Saves a network as Wi-Fi client. On a radio running as Multi AP (the 5 GHz radio of the RUTC50) the network is added to the Multi AP list instead.       Mobile data stays preferred until you change the priority.

bssid.name: BSSID
bssid.description: Access point address from the scan.

forget_wifi.name: Remove Wi-Fi network
forget_wifi.description: Removes a saved Wi-Fi client network by network ID, or an entry of the Multi AP list by SSID. Give one of the two.       The last Multi AP entry cannot be removed.

station_id.name: Network ID
station_id.description: Configuration ID of the saved Wi-Fi client network.

ssid.name: Network name
ssid.description: SSID of a Multi AP list entry.
